description: UAVFlexSimFramework is a measurement-calibrated MATLAB model of a UAV wireless network developed by Md Sharif Hossen at North Carolina State University. The repository README describes separate fixed-trajectory and autonomous-trajectory projects, with movement inside a geofence. The provider compares simulated performance with reports from the NSF AERPAW digital twin under similar network settings. The accompanying Dataset 26 release contains the simulation and emulation observations, including positions, received signal strength, signal-to-noise ratio and data rate. Coverage is the AERPAW experimental configuration, with transfer to other sites requiring suitable parameters and calibration. Access is through a public GitHub repository. No licence was identified in the reviewed metadata; cost and reuse conditions remain uncertain. Caveats include dependence on MATLAB and a provider-reported comparison that was not reproduced here. The model supports wireless digital-twin simulation and UAV trajectory studies. Related record data-aerpaw-matlab-uav-simulation-data describes the associated data independently.
